nodes.text:
HMPV. Another potential pandemic from China. Similar to Covid, but restricted to winter/spring symptoms. Metapneumovirus, to be exact. 
So many illnesses from this source. China ships goods to the world. Are they exporting viruses too -do we need a new Great Wall? 😂🤣
